changelog:
Initial release of protein supplement buying consultant skill.

- Guides users through structured questions about goals, diet, health context, and preferences to create a custom protein supplement specification.
- Considers allergies, dietary restrictions, activity level, and protein needs for safe and personalized recommendations.
- Provides unbiased education on protein type, content, purity, and third-party certification requirements.
- Does not recommend brands until full user profile and specs are established.
- Designed to help users navigate confusing supplement options without marketing bias.
